Copper Pin archive docket
Record: doc-012
Date: 2025-04-28
Collection: Fictional queue-study archive

This docket locates the durability campaign's retained records. The restart ledger is [[doc-008]], the flush-marker proposal is [[doc-013]], and the review addendum is [[doc-014]]. The fault-camera notebook is [[doc-017]].

The campaign name was kept for filing continuity after the queue interface was renamed. The original design is [[doc-003]]. The pilot schedule board [[doc-015]] points to this docket by its older campaign name. The docket supplies navigation and chronology; it contains no new measurements.
